text:
The plan fails several hard requirements. Please apply these corrections and keep everything else unchanged.

**Settings**
- feed: set batch_size to exactly 700 (ttl_s stays at or above 540).
- media: set retry_limit to 6.
- auth: set retry_limit to 5.
- session: set batch_size to exactly 750.
- upload: set ttl_s to 570 (timeout_s stays at 85).
- export: set queue_depth to 420.
- gateway: set batch_size to 250.

**File ownership**
Each file must stay owned by exactly one module, so remove it from its current owner when moving it.
- queues.py belongs to reports (currently in sync).
- policy.py belongs to reports (currently in pricing).
- forms.py belongs to pricing (currently in returns).
- tokens.py belongs to pricing (currently in auth).
- schema.sql belongs to metrics (currently in audit).
- flags.py belongs to upload (currently in cache).
- retry.py belongs to session (currently in cache).
- adapters.py belongs to ingest (currently in shipping).

After the moves, reports owns bench.py, queues.py and policy.py. Pricing owns rules.py, forms.py and tokens.py.

Make sure no module is left without files if that matters to you. Every file must still appear exactly once. Re-check that the remaining requirements still hold after the changes.
